entries.description: Read-only OpenAPI 3.1 description of the Talks API: two GET endpoints over Jared Burrows' conference talks and a static availability probe, with no authentication and no write surface.
representativeQueries: what conference talks has Jared Burrows given
find the video and slides for Jared Burrows' Android talks
list Jared Burrows' presentations by year

entries.description: The talk data itself: a JSON object holding a talks array, newest first, where each talk carries its date, title, venue, location, event link, abstract paragraphs and — where they exist — Speaker Deck and YouTube ids.
representativeQueries: when and where did Jared Burrows speak at Droidcon
get the abstract for Jared Burrows' talk The Road to Single Dex
